tracks.label: Technology
tracks.description: Knowledge technologies and media (writing, codex, paper, print, post, telegraph, photography, computing, networks, platforms, AI)

tracks.label: Institution
tracks.description: HEIs and other higher-learning institutions: foundings, reforms, new organisational forms, changes in governance, credentials, funding, mandate

tracks.label: Distance higher education
tracks.description: Correspondence, broadcast, telecommunication and early network-based higher education; combined-format and open universities

tracks.label: Ecosystem (general)
tracks.description: Actors and framings of the knowledge ecosystem around HEIs, plus cross-cutting recent items (rankings, citation databases, declarations, platforms)

tracks.label: Ecosystem: academies and learned societies
tracks.description: Academies of sciences, learned societies and equivalents

tracks.label: Ecosystem: scholarly communication
tracks.description: Journals, peer review, conferences, publishing, indexing, metrics, rankings, assessment reform

tracks.label: Ecosystem: infrastructures
tracks.description: Libraries, archives, repositories, data and research infrastructures, persistent identifiers

functions.label: Outreach
functions.description: Service, extension, engagement, knowledge transfer, third mission, societal impact; named differently in each period

aspects.label: Administration
aspects.description: Record-keeping and administration in or around HEIs

levels.label: Micro
levels.description: Everyday roles, practices, skills, identities, agency of individual agents (academics, researchers, students, staff)

levels.label: Meso
levels.description: The institution as organisation: degrees, research organisation, governance, business model, boundaries

levels.label: Macro
levels.description: Societal mandate, legitimacy, public purpose, the knowledge system

change_type.label: Form
change_type.description: Organisational or institutional form changed or was created

change_type.label: Function
change_type.description: What the institution or actor does changed

change_type.label: Mixed
change_type.description: More than one of the above

change_type.label: Unclear
change_type.description: Source does not allow a call

cd_reading.label: Continuity
cd_reading.description: The underlying logic persisted, per the source

cd_reading.label: Disruption
cd_reading.description: The underlying logic or actor was displaced or replaced, per the source

cd_reading.label: Layered
cd_reading.description: New forms or media were added and authority rearranged while existing forms persisted (addition or recombination)

cd_reading.label: Mixed
cd_reading.description: Source describes both continuity and disruption in the same item

cd_reading.label: Unclear
cd_reading.description: Source does not allow a call (most ancient and origin events)

valence.label: Not coded
valence.description: Source does not state winners and losers

valence.label: Utopian-leaning
valence.description: Source states mainly beneficial outcomes for the named group

valence.label: Dystopian-leaning
valence.description: Source states mainly harmful outcomes for the named group

date_certainty.label: Stated
date_certainty.description: A year or range is stated in the source

date_certainty.label: Approximate
date_certainty.description: Source uses c., early, mid, period words, or a span inferred by an AI model

date_basis.label: Source year
date_basis.description: Year given in a source output

date_basis.label: Source period words
date_basis.description: Period words in the source converted to years by an AI model (e.g. 8th century)

date_basis.label: Inferred from named period
date_basis.description: Span inferred by an AI model from a named period (e.g. Southern Song, Hellenistic); verify

date_basis.label: AI model general knowledge (unsourced)
date_basis.description: Date supplied by an AI model without a source in the runs; must be sourced or dropped

evidence_labels.label: Observed / documented
evidence_labels.description: Archival, empirical, quantitative or bibliometric findings (literature-search labels OBSERVED or DOCUMENTED)

evidence_labels.label: Expected
evidence_labels.description: Stakeholder expectation or survey, not an observed outcome

evidence_labels.label: Unspecified
evidence_labels.description: No label in the source row

evidence_strength_hint.label: Unrated
evidence_strength_hint.description: Most rows: strength was not captured in the long-list

status.label: Archived candidate
status.description: Taken from a saved AI literature-search output

status.label: Proposed, unsourced
status.description: Added by an AI model from general knowledge; needs a source

status.label: Proposed, partly sourced
status.description: Part (period, tradition or act) sourced in a run; date or detail unsourced

status.label: Proposed, sourced, unverified
status.description: Sourced in a run, not checked against the paper

status.label: Proposed, low verification
status.description: From the web policy pass, summaries only

verification_status.label: Unverified
verification_status.description: Not checked against the underlying papers or documents

run_mode.label: Unknown
run_mode.description: Researcher-run in the web app; paper count not recorded

hypothesis_status.label: Indicative only
hypothesis_status.description: Isolated data points, no systematic test

flag_severity.label: High
flag_severity.description: Affects whether a claim can be shown
